en.description:
Slide colorful bricks to matching gates, swap to match three, and clear your way through 2,000 puzzles. OutBrick brings a different kind of block puzzle to your day: thoughtful moves, playful surprises and a whole Journey of toy-brick villages, with no timer rushing you.

Whether you enjoy sliding puzzles, color sorting or match-3 games, each board invites you to look, plan and try a fresh approach. Play a few levels on a break or settle in for a longer puzzle session. Every level plays offline.

SLIDE, SWAP AND MATCH
• Drag a brick toward open space and choose where it stops. Guide it through a gate of its own color to remove it from the board.
• Swap neighboring single bricks to match three or more of one color. Unmatched swaps bounce back without spending a move. Shaped pieces slide, never swap.
• Make bigger matches to create rockets, bombs and rainbow bricks. Combine their effects to open space and set up your next move.
• Think around long, big, L and T-shaped bricks. A shaped piece moves as one and needs a gate wide enough to fit.

A PUZZLE TO THINK THROUGH
Work out which brick to move first, which gate to reach and how to free a crowded corner. Crates, moss, chests and other obstacles change the way a board opens up. Move limits give each puzzle a goal without a countdown. You can pause to consider a route, put the game down and come back at your own pace.

Hidden bricks and covered rooms add discovery as your Journey continues. Sometimes the best next move creates room for a later one. Hints and optional boosters are there when you want a helping hand; they are tools to choose, not a requirement to buy your way through the game.

2,000 LEVELS, 167 VILLAGES
Follow the Journey through villages built stud by stud from toy bricks. From Garden City to Clover Farm and beyond, each place gives your progress a home. Earn stars, return to earlier puzzles and keep exploring. Your completed levels and purchases stay with your saved progress when you update.

MEET NINE BRICK FRIENDS
Bloo, Peach, Sprout, Bricko, Zippy, Vio, Moss, Flurry and Poppy accompany your adventure with visual animations and text bubbles. They celebrate each clear without character voices.

MORE REASONS TO RETURN
• Three daily Missions give you goals alongside your Journey.
• The Daily Brick reward adds a little celebration to your first clear of the day.
• Explore the Brick Pass and its free reward track.
• Take part in weekly events and seasonal celebrations.
• Compare your progress through Game Center leaderboards and achievements.

PLAY WITH VOICEOVER
Explore bricks and the board through accessible descriptions and actions. VoiceOver helps communicate position, shape and the information available to the player; a hidden brick stays hidden rather than having its color revealed. Color symbols help distinguish pieces without relying on color alone. Adjust the experience with accessibility options and your device's display and motion settings.

PLAY ACROSS YOUR APPLE DEVICES
Play on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with progress synced through iCloud. Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro offer the classic sliding edition. Widgets, Live Activities, Siri and Shortcuts, plus iMessage stickers, bring OutBrick beyond the board.

FREE TO START, CLEAR ABOUT CHOICE
OutBrick is free to play, with optional in-app purchases for coins, boosters, packs and other extras. Lives and move limits are part of the game. Rewarded videos are optional and started by you: there are no banners or automatic interstitial ads between levels. An internet connection is needed for purchases, video ads and online services, but not to play the levels.

Optional game analytics is off by default. You can choose whether to share it and change your choice in Settings. Declining does not restrict your gameplay, rewards or purchases.

Questions or ideas? Tap Community in Settings to find player help and share your feedback.

Find your next satisfying clear: one brick, one clever move and one village at a time.
en.releaseNotes:
More reliable optional game analytics to help us improve OutBrick.

• Clearer reports for level results, shop choices and resources actually added.
• End-of-attempt summaries show how puzzle mechanics are used, without sending board layouts or move coordinates.
• Stronger permission checks before optional rewarded videos load.

Analytics remains off by default. You can change your choice at any time in Settings. Your saved progress and purchases are preserved.

ja.trackName: OutBrick：ブロックパズル・脳トレ
ja.description:
同じ色の門へブロックをすべらせる。となり同士を入れ替えて、3つそろえて消す。OutBrickは、スライドと組み合わせの楽しさがつながる、2,000ステージのブロックパズルです。タイマーに追われず、自分のペースで次の一手を考えられます。

短い休憩に数ステージ、気になる盤面をじっくり解く時間にも。どのステージもオフラインで遊べます。形を見て、通り道を作って、最後のブロックを門へ。少しずつ空いていく盤面の気持ちよさを楽しみましょう。

すべらせる、入れ替える、そろえる
・空いている場所へブロックをドラッグし、止める位置を選びます。同じ色の門まで運ぶと、盤面の外へ出ていきます。
・となり合う1マスのブロックを入れ替えて、同じ色を3つ以上並べると消えます。そろわない入れ替えは元に戻り、手数を使いません。
・長い形、大きな形、L字やT字のピースは、ひとかたまりで動きます。入れ替えずにすべらせ、十分な幅の門を目指しましょう。
・大きくそろえると、ロケット、ボム、レインボーブロックが生まれます。特殊なピースの効果を組み合わせれば、新しい空間を作れます。

道を作る楽しさ
どのブロックから動かす？どの門へ向かう？木箱、コケ、宝箱などの障害物が、ステージごとに違う考え方を引き出します。すぐに消せる組み合わせだけでなく、次の動きにつながる空きマスにも注目してみてください。

ステージには手数の上限がありますが、時間のカウントダウンはありません。難しい場所ではいったん手を止め、形や出口を見直してから進めます。反射神経よりも、盤面を観察して一手を選ぶ楽しさを大切にしています。

隠れたブロックや覆われた部屋は、ジャーニーに小さな発見を加えます。見えていない情報は、遊びながら明らかになっていきます。ヒントやブースターは、助けがほしいときに選ぶ道具。先に進むために、必ずパックを買う必要はありません。

2,000ステージ、167の村
おもちゃのブロックを積み上げた村々を歩くジャーニー。Garden CityやClover Farmから、その先の景色へ。ステージのスコアで星を集め、前の盤面に戻って遊んだり、次の村を訪ねたりできます。更新しても、保存済みの進行状況と購入内容は引き継がれます。

仲間といっしょに
Bloo、Peach、Sprout、Bricko、Zippy、Vio、Moss、Flurry、Poppy。9人のブロックの仲間が、アニメーションと文字の吹き出しでクリアをお祝いします。キャラクターの音声はありません。

毎日の小さな目標
・1日3つのミッションで、ジャーニーとは別の目標にも挑戦。
・デイリーブリックは、その日最初のステージクリアのごほうび。
・Brick Passには無料の報酬トラックがあります。
・毎週のイベントや季節の催しも登場。
・Game Centerのランキングと実績で、進み具合を楽しめます。

いつものステージを解く日も、ミッションを目標にする日も、自分で遊び方を選べます。時計を気にせず、気になる盤面にもう一度取り組んでみましょう。

VoiceOverで盤面を探索
ブロックの位置や形、プレイヤーに見えている情報を説明し、アクセシビリティアクションで移動を選べます。隠れているブロックの色を、読み上げだけで明かすことはありません。

色を区別するための記号もあり、見た目の色だけに頼らずピースを見分けられます。アクセシビリティの設定や端末の表示・動きの設定を使って、遊びやすい体験に調整してください。

Appleデバイスで遊ぶ
iPhone、iPad、Macでプレイし、進行状況はiCloudで同期できます。Apple WatchとApple Vision Proでは、クラシックなスライド版を楽しめます。ウィジェット、ライブアクティビティ、Siri、ショートカット、iMessageステッカーでもOutBrickが身近になります。

選べる追加アイテムと広告
OutBrickは無料でダウンロードでき、コイン、ブースター、パックなどのアプリ内課金は任意です。ライフと手数の上限はゲームの一部です。ステージを開くにはライフが必要ですが、開くだけでは減りません。クリアしても減りません。1手動かしたあとにやめるかやり直す、または手数切れで続行しないと、ライフを1つ使います。

各盤面で最初の「元に戻す」は無料で、そのあとは残っている回数を使います。ヒントや追加の手数など、資源ごとの条件もあります。「時間制限なし」は、手数やアイテムが無制限という意味ではありません。

リワード動画は、自分で選んだときだけ始まります。バナーや、ステージの合間に自動で出る広告はありません。広告の配信状況や報酬の受取条件によって、利用できない場合があります。購入、動画広告、オンラインサービスには通信が必要ですが、ステージを遊ぶための接続は不要です。

ゲームの分析は任意です
ゲーム分析の共有は、最初はオフです。共有するかどうかを選び、あとから設定で変更できます。断っても、ステージ、報酬、購入の利用は制限されません。広告の選択とは別の設定です。

質問やアイデアがあれば、設定の「コミュニティ」へ。プレイヤー向けのヘルプを探したり、感想を届けたりできます。

ひとつの門、ひとつの工夫、その先の村へ。今日の一手をOutBrickで楽しみましょう。
ja.releaseNotes:
任意のゲーム分析の信頼性を高め、OutBrickの改善に役立てます。

• レベルの結果、ショップでの選択、実際に追加されたアイテムなどを、より正確に記録します。
• プレイ終了時の集計で仕掛けの利用状況を把握します。盤面の配置や操作の座標は送信しません。
• 任意のリワード動画を読み込む前の権限確認を強化しました。

分析は引き続き初期設定でオフです。「設定」でいつでも選択を変更できます。保存した進行状況と購入内容は引き継がれます。

de.description:
Schieb einen Stein durch das Tor seiner Farbe – und weg ist er. Tausch zwei Steine und bilde eine Dreierreihe. Räum das Spielfeld leer und sieh zu, wie ein ganzes Dorf aus Bausteinen lebendig wird.

OutBrick ist ein ruhiges, farbenfrohes Block-Puzzle mit 2.000 Levels, neun Steinfreunden und einer Reise durch 167 Dörfer, Noppe für Noppe aus Spielzeugsteinen gebaut. Es gibt nie einen Timer, und jedes Level läuft offline.

SO WIRD GESPIELT
• Zieh einen Stein in Richtung eines freien Felds – er bleibt stehen, wo du loslässt. Schieb ihn ins Tor seiner Farbe, und er verlässt das Spielfeld.
• Zwei benachbarte Steine, die jeweils ein Feld belegen, lassen sich tauschen. Drei oder mehr einer Farbe in einer Reihe verschwinden.
• Größere Kombos bauen Raketen, Bomben und Regenbogensteine. Zünde sie zusammen für riesige Abräumer.
• Lange, große, L- und T-Steine bewegen sich am Stück und passen nur durch ein Tor, das mindestens genauso breit ist.
• Kisten, Moos, Truhen und mehr stellen sich dir in den Weg, und jedes Dorf bringt neue Ideen.

2.000 LEVELS, 167 DÖRFER
Folge einer langen Straße von Garden City und Clover Farm bis Ember Volcano, Pirate Harbor und Spaceport Gardens. Die Dörfer haben bis zu zwölf Levels (das letzte acht), und 28 aus Steinen gebaute Orte bringen eigene Farben und Wahrzeichen mit. Die Levels werden sanft schwerer, mit schweren, sehr schweren und Boss-Levels als echtes Gehirntraining.

NEUN STEINFREUNDE
Bloo, Peach, Sprout, Bricko, Zippy, Vio, Moss, Flurry und Poppy begleiten dich durch jedes Level und feiern jedes leere Spielfeld mit dir.

JEDEN TAG ETWAS NEUES
Drei tägliche Missionen, der Tagesstein, ein Brick Pass mit Gratis-Pfad, wöchentliche Events und Feste zur Saison, dazu Bestenlisten und Erfolge im Game Center.

KEINE HEKTIK
Die Rätsel in OutBrick haben keinen Timer. Jedes Level hat ein Zuglimit und du hast alle Zeit der Welt, deinen nächsten Zug zu planen. Das erste Rückgängig in jedem Level ist gratis. Weitere Rückgängig-Aktionen nutzen deinen verfügbaren Vorrat.

BEDIENUNGSHILFEN
• Spielfeldbeschreibungen und eigene Aktionen für VoiceOver. Die Farbe verdeckter Steine wird nicht angesagt.
• Symbole für Farbenblinde sind ab Werk an.
• Unterstützt Größeren Text, Bewegung reduzieren, Blinkende Lichter abdunkeln, Kontrast erhöhen und Intelligent invertieren.

AUF APPLE-GERÄTEN
Spiel auf iPhone, iPad und Mac, dein Fortschritt bleibt über iCloud synchron. Apple Watch (als eigenständiges Spiel) und Apple Vision Pro spielen die klassische Schiebe-Edition der Levels. Dazu Widgets, Live-Aktivitäten, Siri und Kurzbefehle sowie eine iMessage-App mit Stickern.

FAIR GESPIELT
OutBrick ist kostenlos, mit optionalen In-App-Käufen. Normalerweise brauchst du ein Leben, um ein Level zu öffnen. Ein Level zu starten oder zu gewinnen kostet nie ein Leben: Du verlierst eines nur, wenn du nach einem Zug aufhörst oder neu startest oder keine Züge mehr hast und nicht weiterspielst – und alle 30 Minuten kommt eines zurück. Werbung gibt es nur als Belohnungsvideos, die du selbst wählst: keine Banner, keine Interstitials. Pässe verlängern sich nie von selbst.

Fragen oder Ideen? Tippe in den Einstellungen auf Community, um zur OutBrick Community zu kommen.
de.releaseNotes:
Zuverlässigere optionale Spielanalysen helfen uns, OutBrick zu verbessern.

• Genauere Berichte zu Levelergebnissen, Entscheidungen im Shop und tatsächlich hinzugefügten Ressourcen.
• Zusammenfassungen am Ende eines Versuchs zeigen, wie Spielmechaniken genutzt werden, ohne Spielfeldanordnungen oder Zugkoordinaten zu übertragen.
• Verbesserte Berechtigungsprüfungen vor dem Laden freiwilliger Belohnungsvideos.

Die Analyse bleibt standardmäßig ausgeschaltet. Du kannst deine Entscheidung jederzeit in den Einstellungen ändern. Dein gespeicherter Fortschritt und deine Käufe bleiben erhalten.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
OutBrick 3.0 — built for iOS 26 and 27, with Apple Intelligence on board.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE, ON DEVICE
• Bloo, Peach and Sprout speak for themselves. Their lines are written on the fly by Apple's on-device foundation model — in your language, in each character's own voice, and never the same twice.
• Ask Siri "how am I doing in OutBrick?" and the answer comes back as a sentence from your favourite mascot, with your real level, streak and coin count in it.
• Everything runs on your device. Nothing you play is sent anywhere.

A BOARD THAT SHOWS YOU WHAT IT COSTS
• Three live star pips sit in the clock while you play. The second goes out the moment you pass the move target; the third the instant you tap Undo. You watch a star go, in the frame that spends it.
• The move counter and the target no longer disagree: one number, one meaning.
• Every board still proves itself — a solver clears all 2,000 before they ship.

NEW WAYS IN AND OUT
• Arm boosters before your first move, and the card says plainly that they are spent win or lose.
• Unlimited-lives windows — an hour, three hours or a full day where no board costs a life.
• A rescue offer after a third failure on the same board, capped at one a day, with the saving shown against the shop's own prices.

ACROSS EVERYTHING YOU OWN
• Apple Watch is a real OutBrick now: three stars on the phone's exact rule, live star pips, chapters, and a restart for a wedged board.
• Home screen and Control Centre widgets, Live Activities on the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island, an iMessage sticker pack, and challenge links you can send to a friend.
• Game Center: two daily leaderboards, two lifetime, 57 achievements and head-to-head challenges.
• iCloud keeps your level, stars, streak and collection the same on every device.

AND
• Twelve languages, with the game and the App Store page in all of them.
• Colour-blind support from day one: a distinct glyph on every brick and every gate.
• 2,000 authored levels across 100 chapters — and it keeps generating them after that.

A world tour in bricks. 167 villages. Every one a real place.

BUILD YOUR WAY AROUND THE WORLD
Dubai. Algiers. Marrakesh. Paris. Rome. London. New York. Every village on the Journey map is a real city, rebuilt brick by brick — its landmarks standing by the road where you can see them. Twelve levels to a village, so you can always see the far end from where you're standing.

THE MAP IS ALIVE NOW
Your village's host walks the roadside. Friends stand together and talk. Snow falls in the cold villages, clouds drift over all of them, and the water moves at every crossing. The trees are stacked brick courses, the houses have lit windows and a chimney through the roof, and the road finally reads as a road — even on the sandy villages, where it used to vanish.

A BOARD THAT TELLS YOU WHAT IT COSTS
A new header, the same rounded panel the map and the Brick Pass wear. Lives live inside the heart. Moves left is one big number in the middle — it rolls as you spend, turns amber as the rope runs short, and red when it's nearly gone. Three stars sit above it on a bar that slides as you play, so you watch a star go in the frame that spends it.

FEWER WORDS. BETTER ONES.
The board used to explain itself in sentences. Now it says "One Star". "Beat 12". "Board Cleared!" — one word, once, and out of your way.

BOARDS THAT MAKE YOU THINK
We tightened the rope. Every board is still provably solvable — all 2,000, checked move by move — but the slack is gone, and the level before each village gate now asks something of you. Slide first, think second, and you'll feel it.

A NEW ICON
Made from the game itself. The real board, the real bricks — not a drawing of them.

ALSO IN THIS RELEASE
• A weekly leaderboard that's actually weekly, counting the boards you clear.
• We'll tell you when your lives come back.
• Accessibility features declared on the App Store: VoiceOver, Differentiate Without Colour, Reduced Motion and a dark interface.
• A refused move at a wrong-colour door is now visible with Reduce Motion on, not just audible.
• The Lock Screen counts your moves the way the board does.
• One launch screen instead of two.

OutBrick 3.4 — the board feels alive, the map is a world, and the leaderboard is for everyone.

A BOARD YOU CAN FEEL
• Pick up a brick and its lane lights up under it, all the way to where it will stop — white on a wall, the door's colour on a door that will take it.
• Every stud line you cross clicks, a note higher each cell. Bricks lean into their travel and raise a little dust when they land after a run.
• Every door your brick can leave by breathes while you hold it. Ice cracks along the frame and shatters off the rim when it thaws.
• Chain exits and lightning arcs along the rim between the doors. The Rocket blasts its lane, the UFO beams up a whole colour, and the last brick of a board leaves in slow motion under a gold bloom.
• From the fourth link of a chain, and on every clear, the header itself says the word.

THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER, REDESIGNED
• Out of moves: the continue price is shown up front, the free ad option beside it, and the Rescue Pack right there when you need it.
• Board clear: stars land one by one, the coin receipt counts up, and the piggy bank fills in front of you. Watch an ad to double the whole card.
• A new level-start card lets you arm Rocket, UFO or Hint before the first move — from your stock, with coins, or with one ad.

WIN STREAKS, THE BRICK WHEEL AND MORE
• Clear boards in a row and boosters arrive armed for the next one; keep your streak alive for coins when a board beats you.
• Spin the daily Brick Wheel on Home for boosters and coins. Collect UFO parts with every clear.
• Unlimited-lives hours are one tap away on the refill card, marked ∞ like everywhere else.

THE JOURNEY
• A rolling, curved world under your feet: villages of twelve levels with their own landmarks, roads that end and begin, rivers with fords and stepping stones.
• Fourteen new landmarks and twenty-nine new scenery friends — camels, flamingos, penguins, a robot dog, a unicorn.
• The nine friends walk in and out of Home and celebrate a clear with a move of their own.

LEADERS, FOR EVERYONE
• No sign-in wall. Weekly and all-time boards work with or without Game Center, with your country flag beside your name.

AND
• A whole new sound library, composed for the game: happy, bouncy music with real instrument voices, a tune for every tab, and a note for everything you do.
• Twelve languages, colour-blind glyphs on every brick and gate, 2,000 authored levels and more generated after them.

OutBrick 4.2 — a harder game, on a Journey rebuilt in brick.

THE BOARDS ASK MORE OF YOU
You told us every level was too easy. You were right, and this is the release that starts to answer it.
• The whole 2,000-board pack was rebuilt against a bar that rises with the chapter: the opening levels have to resist a shallow search, the middle chapters a deeper one, and the late game deeper still.
• 1,301 of the 2,000 boards carry new layouts. Every board is still proven solvable, and every board can still be cleared without spending anything.
• This is the first pass at it rather than a finished job. Some boards still open more gently than we want, and that work carries on.

NO CLOCK ANYWHERE
• Rush is withdrawn from the whole game. Nothing in OutBrick is timed any more — the per-board move limit is the only rope. Rush Weekend becomes Target Weekend and pays for beating the move target instead.

THE JOURNEY IS BUILT OUT OF BRICK
• Nothing on the map is a painted picture any more. All 167 villages build their ground, roads, props and landmarks out of brick as you travel, from twenty-eight designed places — Garden City, Clover Farm, Seashell Beach, Ember Volcano, Snowflake Village, Mushroom Forest, Pirate Harbor, Spaceport and twenty more.
• Each place has its own palette, its own road surface, its own props and landmarks, its own level-chip shape and its own motion.
• The road comes round six times on the way to level 2,000, and every pass is a different hour of the day: First Light, Market Day, Festival Gardens, Hidden Courtyards, Windmill Walk and Grand Promenade. All 167 stops read as different places.
• Journey now sits in the centre of the tab bar, where you can step straight back out onto the map.
• Home is built from the same brick vocabulary as the road.

LINKS THAT WORK AGAIN
• Home Screen quick actions, a challenge link from a friend, Spotlight results, Handoff and every widget tap now open the screen they name instead of dropping you on Home.

ASK FOR A FRIEND BY NAME
• Siri and Shortcuts can bring any of the nine friends onto the Home stage by name.

EASIER TO READ
• Secondary text on dark panels is lighter, measured to clear the 4.5:1 contrast minimum rather than judged by eye.
• At the accessibility text sizes, labels on Leaders, Pass, Profile and Home wrap instead of losing their last word to an ellipsis.
• Colour-blind glyphs, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion are unchanged and still on from the first launch.

ON THE BOARD
• Pick a brick up and the board marks where it would come to rest in each direction.
• Counted gates and iced gates no longer look alike, and gate contrast is measured against every chapter frame and sky rather than judged by eye.
• The gate-crossing sound is gone. It fired constantly and told you nothing.

WORTH COMING BACK FOR
• The icon badge counts what you have already earned and not collected — finished missions, a daily brick, Pass tiers due, a village reward waiting, a full life tank. It counts trips, not rewards, so it stops at nine and can always be cleared.

A NEW APP ICON
• Bloo — the real 3D character rather than a drawing of him — stands on a course of gold, coral and teal bricks over a glowing violet burst, with no border at all.

NOTHING MOVED IN THE SHOP
• No price, no purchase and no economy rule changed. Lives still come back on their own, the first undo on every board is still free, and every board can still be cleared without spending.

OutBrick 4.5 — sealed rooms, hidden bricks, and nine friends who finally look their best.

NEW ON THE BOARD
• Sealed rooms: from level 33, parts of a board sit behind a lid. Open it by clearing enough bricks, by clearing one colour, with a stained-glass colour key, after a brass move clock counts down, or through a numberless keyhole. Every board is still proven solvable.
• Face-down "?" bricks turn over only when a neighbour leaves the board — so plan ahead.
• Escalators and elevators carry bricks across the board.
• Hints now come from a real solution: the first move of an actual path to the exit.
• The boards were re-sorted so a level's difficulty badge matches the board on it, and 137 boards that were too easy were rebuilt.
• Move limits now tighten as you climb the levels. They never drop below what the board needs, with room to spare.

MUSIC AND SOUND
• Two new licensed songs: one that follows you through every menu, one for all 2,000 boards.
• A new, lighter set of toy-brick, coin and celebration sounds, with the busier effects taken out.

YOUR BRICK FRIENDS, REFINED
• All nine friends were remodelled: seamless backpack straps, a tidy compass cord and wristwatch for Bloo, and flush packs with their own shapes for Sprout, Bricko, Zippy, Vio, Flurry and Poppy. Poppy now really holds her wand, and nobody's arms pass through scarves or headphones any more.
• Every friend's speech bubbles now come in all twelve languages.
• Your own friend now stars in your notifications, widgets, Live Activity and iMessage stickers, and all nine have stickers.
• The Live Activity friend frets when three moves or fewer are left.
• VoiceOver users can now tickle a friend and hear what it says.
• A new Control Centre button: Meet a friend.

A NEW APP ICON
• Bloo, the real 3D character, stands behind a course of bricks with his mittens resting on top, over a glowing violet burst.

APPLE WATCH, REBUILT
• The watch plays like the phone: the same touch feel on the board, the same sounds, live 3D friends on Home and after a clear, and the phone's missions, Pass, Shop, Leaders and Journey.
• Watch reminders: your watch nudges you when a board is waiting or your lives are full, without doubling up with your phone.
• Your watch and iPhone now share one save through iCloud, so lives, purchases and progress stay in step.

IPAD, MAC, APPLE VISION PRO AND APPLE TV
• iPad: play with a hardware keyboard (arrow keys, Tab, ⌘Z) and see a one-time keyboard tip. Mac: translated menus and layout fixes for Mac windows.
• Apple Vision Pro runs the full game in its window.

NOTIFICATIONS
• The number on the app icon now only counts rewards that are really waiting for you, and a message from us no longer changes it.
• News from OutBrick now shows even while you're playing, quietly, without a sound.

EASIER TO READ AND USE
• Speech bubbles grow with large text instead of clipping, on Home and on the Journey map.
• Reduce Motion now also calms the friends' tilt-to-look and their reactions.
• The Daily Brick and Streak widgets say what earns today's brick: clear a board.

NOTHING MOVED IN THE SHOP
• No price changed. Lives still come back on their own, the first undo on every board is still free, and every board can still be cleared without spending anything.

OutBrick 5.0 is the biggest update we have ever made.

• Swap and match, everywhere. All 2,000 boards now play like the classics you love: swap two bricks to line up three, four or five of a colour. Lines of four make line blasters, L and T shapes make bombs, five in a row makes a colour bomb, and every pair of specials combines into something bigger. Tap a special to set it off.
• Cascades you can watch. Bricks fall, slide diagonally around fountains, statues and garden beds, and stream back in from the top, so the village floor shows through between waves.
• Gates on every board. Match a brick in front of the gate of its colour and watch it fly out. Iced gates thaw, counted gates close, and some boards ask you to send a colour home.
• Every board proven. A solver clears each of the 2,000 boards before it ships, and a board can never leave you without a move.
• The friends dress for the village. All nine brick friends wear an outfit for each of the 167 villages, or the one you pick in the new Wardrobe: 87 outfits, plates, palettes, brick finishes, celebrations, trails and frames.
• Accessibility, deeper than ever. Play every board with VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control or a keyboard. A new Accessibility tab in Settings brings together colour-blind glyphs, a high-contrast board, animation speed, how much VoiceOver says, a left-handed tray and Hold to confirm. The Journey map now tells you where you are with a two-finger double tap.
• Friends that speak beside you. Speech bubbles now sit next to the friend who is talking, and never over your goals or your bricks.
• New ways to keep playing. Build your own rescue at the end of a board, pick a booster box that fits the goal you missed, or take a Rescue Week of unlimited lives. Everything is optional, and every board can still be cleared without spending.

Thank you for every message about 5.0. This update is built from your feedback.

• Faster with VoiceOver. A move's result is now spoken the moment you make it, instead of after the animation, and VoiceOver keeps its place on the brick you moved.
• Hints speak again. Ask for a hint and VoiceOver tells you which brick to swap and which way, then takes you to it.
• Gates explained. Every gate tells you how to use it, and a brick standing in front of its own gate says so.
• Settings that explain themselves. Every option in Settings › Accessibility now says what it does.
• More VoiceOver tools. A two-finger double tap gives you a hint on a board, a two-finger scrub closes any screen, new rotors jump to specials, goals, blockers and gates, and an optional row sound lets you hear where the colours sit.
• Boards finish when you win. The board ends the moment your goals are met. Every move you have left turns into a line blaster for a bigger score, and more stars.
• Goals that look like your bricks. Goal icons now match the board's bricks exactly, in every village and colour palette, and a finished goal stays in its own colour.
• Siri, without opening the game. Ask how many lives you have, when the next one comes back, about today's Daily Brick, or how many stars you have in a village.
• Find OutBrick everywhere. Spotlight learns which levels and villages you play, Visual Intelligence can find a matching village or friend from a photo of toy bricks, and widgets come forward in your Smart Stack when there is something to do.
• Focus filters. Choose whether a Focus such as Sleep or Work turns off the music and pauses OutBrick's reminders.
• Fresh design. The level card, the wardrobe and the shop tiles now wear OutBrick's own colours, with clearer text.

OutBrick 5.1 changes how every board plays.

• Slide & Match, on all 2,000 boards. Boards have room to move now. Swipe a brick toward an empty space and it stops where you let go. Slide it into the gate of its colour and it goes home. Swipe it into a neighbour to swap them, and lines of three or more still clear. A gate's goal counts both the bricks you send home and the ones of its colour you clear.
• Twelve kinds of board, village after village. On some, bricks fall and new ones drop in; on others nothing falls, and the board opens up as you play. Long, big, L and T bricks slide as one piece and leave only through a gate as wide as they are. Crates, ice, locks, moss, statues, sealed beds, iced gates and counted gates get in the way, and the gates now fill the board's border.
• Learn as you go. Each new idea gets a short card the first time you meet it, and a solver finds a winning line for every board before it ships.
• Slide with VoiceOver. Every brick that can move offers its slides as actions, such as "Slide right 1 cell", "Slide up to the end, 3 cells" or "Slide left, out through the red gate". VoiceOver says where the brick stopped and what went home, and hints name slides as well as swaps.
• The OutBrick Community. Community and Report a bug, new in Settings, open our community on the website: ask for help, report a bug or vote for ideas. Report a bug fills in your device, its system version, the app version, your level and whether VoiceOver, Switch Control or Larger Text is on, so you can go straight to what happened.
• Settings in Liquid Glass. The switches and choices in Settings are now Liquid Glass, in OutBrick's own green and red.
• Easier to watch. Blasts and falling bricks play a little slower, so you can see what happened, and the board takes your next move as soon as it is still.

OutBrick 5.1.1 fixes a board that could seem frozen.

• When extra moves arrived while a tip card was on screen, the card could vanish while still blocking the board. VoiceOver found only the card, and your next swipe was spent putting it away. The tip card now stays until you're done with it, and the board takes your next move straight away.

OutBrick 5.1.2 refines VoiceOver and makes the whole game snappier.

• VoiceOver stays where you are. Reading the board no longer counts as standing idle, so no offer pops up over the board while you explore, and focus no longer jumps back to the top of the board.
• Explore by touch finds every brick, gate and empty cell where it is drawn, on older iPhones and iOS versions too. A gap in a board says "No cell here".
• When a card closes, VoiceOver goes back to where you were, and no screen is left silent behind it.
• A hint no longer moves focus to a brick that has already gone.
• New in Settings › Accessibility: Hints when idle. Turn it off to work boards out yourself; the Hint booster and Read the board still help.
• Home and the Journey map are lighter with VoiceOver: less lag, less heat, better battery.
• Countdowns are read in minutes and no longer change under your finger every second.
• On the Journey map, VoiceOver's Actions rotor now opens Missions.

Thank you to everyone on AppleVis and in the OutBrick Community who reported these. Please keep telling us what you find.

OutBrick 5.2 is our biggest update yet.

• Ten new villages: levels 13–132 rebuilt with brand-new boards. Swap and slide on fresh shapes, including a board split into two islands. Your stars and progress stay exactly where they were.
• New ideas to discover, each shown once with a quick hand gesture: counted gates, conveyor belts, face-down bricks and portals.
• More villages arrive without an app update. Look for the "More villages coming" sign at the end of the Journey.
• A new Home: your furthest village, by day, at dusk and under a night sky.
• OutBrick now speaks 39 languages, with prices always in your own currency.
• Ask Siri "What level am I on in OutBrick?" or "When are my lives full?"
• Clearer VoiceOver descriptions on the board, in every language.

The first 372 boards now follow the updated village design. All 2,000 level addresses remain playable; later boards are still part of the existing catalogue as we bring the new foundation to more villages.

Welcome to OutBrick 5.3: more villages to explore, more thoughtful accessibility and a fresh polish for your next little adventure.

20 MORE VILLAGES TO DISCOVER
• Continue beyond level 132 with 240 rebuilt puzzles across 20 additional villages, taking the updated village boards through level 372. Discover new layouts, colorful surroundings and more ways to slide, swap and match.
• Your existing level addresses, stars, progress and purchases stay with you. The Journey still offers 2,000 puzzles, and the core levels remain playable offline, at your own pace.

YOUR BRICK FRIENDS, BEAUTIFULLY ANIMATED
• The nine familiar friends keep their approved look in prepared animations and pictures, with expressive celebrations and text bubbles on the board.
• Settings is simpler: the old Auto / 3D / 2D Friends selector is gone.
• Reduce Motion brings calmer star, goal and celebration effects. Settings choice feedback now respects your Haptics preference.

MORE THOUGHTFUL VOICEOVER PLAY
• Gate guidance now explains sliding to the exit, with directions that account for the width needed by shaped bricks. Face-down bricks keep their secret color out of spoken gate hints.
• Modal cards follow a clearer reading order: title, Close, then their scrollable content. This makes it easier to understand an offer and reach its actions.
• Purchase buttons on board offers include the product, price and relevant contents or duration in their VoiceOver descriptions and hints. Decorative offer artwork stays out of the reading sequence so the useful information comes through.
• The Shop now communicates unavailable products with the correct disabled state, while keeping Loading or Soon readable. Those offers cannot start a purchase until StoreKit makes them available.
• When a Move Booster Pass is active, VoiceOver describes unlimited moves instead of reading the old move budget or giving low-move warnings.

These refinements bring the board, cards and Shop closer together, with clearer words and more consistent controls. Thank you for helping us make OutBrick welcoming to more players. Your next village is waiting.
